description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named AllowedPermission used for encapsulating permission flags (read, create, update, delete) in an HRM system. It includes methods to instantiate the object from an array and to query individual permissions.

classes.name: AllowedPermission
classes.description: A DTO representing permission flags (read, create, update, delete) with factory method and permission check methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the permission flags with provided boolean values.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an AllowedPermission instance from an associative array of permission flags.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.
